record.rationale: Actual native preview sets feed source optional fonts,InitScriptTypes/CheckScript,bounds,fitting,color decisions and draw positions. Canvas measures actual host fonts;SVG paints source weight/posture/decorations without intercepting row pointer input. Browser shaping,available faces and rasterization remain host-owned;no native pixel parity claim.
